messages:
sarah_support: FYI customer ACME (prod) reporting large latency spikes and intermittent 5xx since ~2025-07-15T10:15Z. They say requests originate from NA but are being handled in eu-west. tenant=acme-prod

maria_prod: I can see error-rate and retries in support logs. A lot of auth 401s and long tail token validation. Seems correlated with a capacity warmup event.

tyler_oncall: Can you paste a sample request id + headers? suspect token-region binding is stale when a request is auto-diverted to another region.

sarah_support: Example (redacted):
```
curl -i -H \"Authorization: Bearer tok_ABC123\" -H \"X-Redwood-Region: na-west\" https://api.redwood.com/v1/generate
```
Response headers from customer: `x-handled-region: eu-west`, `x-auth-status: scope_mismatch`, status 401 for some attempts, 200 for others. RequestIDs: r-2301 r-2307 r-2319

irina_sre: Checking infra: na-west GPU pool saw rapid ramps from a new customer warmup job; node saturation hit ~95% which triggered the auto-divert policy. Fallback target chosen was eu-west because it's the closest compatible shard. We have a known race where token->region cache TTL (120s) can cause a scope mismatch if the request is validated against the original region but executed elsewhere.

tyler_oncall: Repro steps I used: 1) fire 250 RPS with na-west routing keys, 2) saturate na-west shard capacity, 3) observe `route.divert` events and subsequent auth 401s in the same request window. I can reproduce locally with the ramp script.

maria_prod: Also flagged a billing anomaly: client SDK retries on 401 cause duplicate generation charges. Customer reported unexpected credits usage spike.

tyler_oncall: Immediate mitigations proposed: 
- raise auto-divert threshold from 0.85 -> 0.99 for na-west to avoid premature diversions during warmup
- add a short sticky routing TTL (30s) for recently diverted sessions
- short-circuit SDK retries on `scope_mismatch` to avoid double-billing

deploy-bot: routing-config: update applied by tyler_oncall at 2025-07-15T12:13:20Z - safe-divert-threshold=0.99, sticky-ttl=30s

irina_sre: Observability after change: divert-event-rate down ~82%, auth.scope_mismatch down 78% in the affected tenant's window.

maria_prod: Customer notified: ACME confirmed latency returned to baseline and billing anomaly reduced. They requested follow-up on SDK behavior.

tyler_oncall: Filed INC-4821: "Ensure diverted requests carry region-hints + SDK retry guard on scope_mismatch". Owners: eng-runtime + devex.

sarah_support: Thanks all :heart: Leaving ticket open until INC-4821 lands.
